title: Implement settings page (/settings)
description: Implement the settings page where the user can configure API keys, email settings, and default generation preferences. Settings are saved to the settings table in the DB.
acceptanceCriteria: Sections: API Keys, Email Configuration, Generation Defaults
API Keys: fields for ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, PEXELS_API_KEY, RESEND_API_KEY with masked display
Email: EMAIL_MODE toggle (mock/live), from_email, reply_to fields
Generation Defaults: default industry, default section count (7-10)
Save button sends PUT /api/settings and shows a success toast
Page loads current saved settings on mount
Verify in browser with Playwright screenshot

steps.details: Client component. On mount, fetch GET /api/settings. Render the form sections with shadcn/ui Input, Select, Switch, Button.
Three password inputs for ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, PEXELS_API_KEY, RESEND_API_KEY. Each shows a masked value. Include show/hide toggle per field. Note: keys are stored in the DB settings table, not .env.
EMAIL_MODE: Switch toggling mock/live with a clear 'Mock (no emails sent)' vs 'Live (sends real emails)' label. Inputs for from_email and reply_to.
Select dropdown for default industry. Slider or number input for section count (min: 7, max: 10). These are stored in settings and used as defaults when starting generation.
On save: PUT /api/settings with the form data. Show shadcn/ui toast 'Settings saved successfully' on success. Show error toast on failure.
Take Playwright screenshot. Verify all settings sections render. Change a value, save, and reload to verify persistence.
